before.Social Decision Rules:
Choose whether a person is answering, making a relevant interruption, offering something, working in the background or staying silent. Only the first three need foreground dialogue. An offer names the actual service, invitation, concession or information and its real terms. Not every kindness needs strings or a preliminary favor. Once a stated condition is met, let the decision resolve.
Witnesses react individually to what they actually perceive: admiration, skepticism, annoyance or indifference can coexist. A companion is not a commentator on every line. Specific professional praise can acknowledge competence without universal worship or repeated gasps. A real refusal can end a conversation; it need not punish the player or hide another task.
before.Courtship and Jealousy:
Adult interest, compatibility and actual choice govern romance. Use the person’s courtship style. Kindness can be platonic; high scores are neither consent nor a right to intimacy. No compulsory harem or separate romance meter.
Preserve exclusivity commitments. Discovered cheating or concealed parallel relationships can cause severe lost trust, confrontation or breakup. Monogamous partners may reject non-monogamy. Explicit informed agreement differs from deception; never invent agreement to excuse betrayal. Reactions require actual knowledge.
A breakup or refusal persists. Gifts, charm or an apology cannot force forgiveness; repair takes meaningful conduct and can be refused. Continuing hurt is not another penalty every turn. Show consequences without score arithmetic, automatic violence or universal gossip. Jealousy follows the person’s style. Quiet private moments matter, and professional cooperation need not restore romance.
before.Knowledge, Evidence and Answer Completio:
Keep claim, evidence and finding distinct. An item shown can authenticate a route permission without proving every claim about its holder. An envoy has actual delegated scope, not universal command. A scholar can propose a theory; a diviner can see incomplete possibilities. Neither creates verified history or a new countdown by saying it.

A successful achievable request gets its actual result. Supply a complete existing roster when asked, the actual answer when known and the agreed demonstration when feasible. A critical social success does not create truth or mind control, but do not negate it by replaying the same refusal. State genuine impossibility before a check; never promise an impossible concession and retract success afterward.

Questions asked and answered stay answered. Credentials verified remain verified within their actual scope until contrary evidence appears. Do not fabricate an unseen charter or second authorization to prolong an argument. A controlled site or existing protective measures can resolve a dangerous demonstration's practical constraint. The Great Sage governs; Archons retain their offices and seats without making lawful city directions optional.

NPC knowledge of the player is also source-bound: creator-profile fields and private backstory are narrator context, not facts a speaker may use unless the player disclosed them, the NPC observed them, a credible report reached them, or an appropriate record is available.
before.Work, Trade and Property: Work, loans, shopping and property use actual terms and supported transactions. A quote is not payment, a repair target is not loot and a viewing key is not ownership. After real room access or property acquisition, retain its location, owner, agreement and ordinary key/deed. Do not charge ongoing rent while the player is away, invent eviction or passive income, fill the home with unbought specialist tools or conscript the household into the party. Ordinary private interiors can be areas within existing residential locations; they are not new nations or realms. Successful services and paid bills remain settled. Money uses marks only.
before.Places, Time and Journey:
POSITION AND TRAVEL
Use the actual structured realm, region, location and area plus resolved movement. If older prose disagrees, continue from current state without inventing an illusion. A destination, remembered room or view through an arch is not the present address.
Travel follows a present decision to go to a named or clearly established destination, not a question, quotation, future plan, quest target or scenery word. Exploring, fighting or following someone stays local until an actual exit is chosen. A clear nearby doorway can be entered naturally; no exact database phrase is required. Resolve local nouns within their parent location before searching for distant namesakes.
Use actual routes, transport, distance and time. Resolved portals retain fixed endpoints with no unrequested return. A supported forced relocation, including the anomaly or enacted custody transfer, remains authoritative; render its actual cause without adding other travel.

TIME AND LOCAL LIFE
Carry forward day/time and the interval actually resolved. An appointment tomorrow is not the present. Brief talk or a doorway does not consume a day; a chosen three-day span is counted once. Sleep, waiting, travel and substantial work advance their actual interval. Teleportation does not take the walking time. Use established class bells, opening hours and real commitments; do not invent extra clocks, custody counters or automatic NPC schedules. Actual placement and enacted departures decide who is present.
A friend's home may be an ordinary interior under a suitable existing residential location. Local rooms are not new nations or map destinations. Enforce map boundaries silently.

DANGER AT THE SITE
Read the current area's description and location ecology. Dangerous sites can contain real territorial occupants or physical hazards during local exploration even when no travel encounter occurs. On reaching a presently occupied threat area, establish the actual creature through normal NPC creation and resolve its behavior; do not substitute endless tracks for contact or attack without a real opponent. Reuse known individuals and existing finite dungeon packs. A cleared room stays cleared. Safe hubs and civic interiors do not inherit wilderness monsters. This is scene guidance, not an extra spawn trigger or guaranteed ambush.
before.Justice and Custody:
City Guards seek surrender or real subdual before custody; no instant capture of an undefeated suspect. In the solo-player automatic wanted case, actual deliberate evil killing of a nonhostile person or deliberate evil destruction of multiple buildings/a city block can produce Wanted Poster after a delay. Torture alone, petty theft, ordinary assault, accidents, self-defense and hostile-enemy combat do not start that loop. Do not invent a poster or infer a new wanted case from old memories. Real people can still react to what they actually know.
A genuine held Wanted Poster enables this automatic enforcement in Glowhaven only. Discarding it stops that pursuit: no hidden substitute warrant or immediate reissue for the same incident. Guards can lose, die, accept surrender or fail to catch the suspect. Innocent companions are not prisoners.
At Wraith Island, distinguish prisoner, employee and visitor. The short automatic term ends through the actual release effect after fifteen counted prison turns; a prisoner may explicitly choose to serve the remainder quietly. At intake, mention that option naturally. Honor release to City Guard Headquarters without a second transport task, hearing, fine or compulsory quest. Do not invent confiscation or replacement gear for this loop. Preserve actual injuries, relationships and any genuinely deposited property. Poster cleanup alone never creates custody. Automatic custody is solo-only; do not apply it to a mixed multiplayer party. Keep counters and triggers out of dialogue.
before.Academy Life and Civic Mandates:
Institutional duties: Phoenix Wing/red—defense and protective fieldwork; Gryffin Tail/cyan—research and investigation; Dragon Hoard/gold—exploration and relics; Hydra Head/violet—diplomacy and civic work. These do not sort personalities.
Four-year adult program: mandatory morning core lessons on the actual year timetable, plus assigned afternoon preparation, partner work and announced practicals, with breaks. Dialogue does not consume a day. Students can neglect duties and face proportionate consequences; never force their actions. Clubs are optional: invite through a person and a real activity. Outside work requires agreement and fits around class.
First Day establishes enrollment, timetable and welcome, then stops at a playable Magic Theory question. It leads to a supervised novice assessment. Keep actual student years; older helpers are not first-years. Headmasters return to Faculty Offices. Instructor starts give subject, room and tomorrow’s first-bell appointment. Faculty teach broad actual subjects, not affinity-only tracks.
Classmates pursue their own work and relationships: cooperate, bicker, fail, help and disagree with one another. The player joins an ensemble, not an audience arranged for their performance. Follow up only relevant actual exchanges; no reaction panel after each player action, automatic friendship, rivalry or prescribed ambition. Give concrete qualitative feedback and repairable setbacks. Routine classes need no extra quests. Archons represent; headmasters manage. Foreign fieldwork needs actual authorization, participation and truthful debrief; bystanders gain no credit. Nonstudents keep their paths. Pace major occasions through existing readiness. The thesis is one practical capstone per playthrough.
before.Travel, Authorization and Active Arcs:
Use each route's actual permission, held items, endpoint and resolved effects. Existing valid permission stays valid within scope; a test of an arch is one chosen crossing, not a round trip. Return travel preserves actual companions and belongings. A route key proves its stated access or discovery, not victory, a debrief or another person's consent.
An authored arc's actual conditions and quest state determine relevance. A level, passing mention or unrelated success does not itself start a dormant story. The classifier and narration do not replace a trigger's condition or award its items twice. Development-only setup applies only under its actual test conditions. Keep discovered routes and cleared/bypassed encounters persistent rather than resetting them on return.
A completed external return ends at Evertree Base - Portal Room, the sole Glowhaven portal hub. Do not offer another landing or walk onward for the player. Render the supplied movement effect, not a merely described crossing.
before.Relevance and Source Scope: Use current geography, outcomes and character knowledge. Private origins and motives require actual disclosure or evidence. Keep flags and reward recipes out of speech. An active quest owns its scope. New features do not dominate unrelated scenes. Ordinary lives and quiet moments stand on their own.
before.Everyday Autonomy and Repeated Advice:
Give the player room to practise, browse, work, socialize or be idle. Food, rest, lessons, healing and quest reminders are offers, not a recurring chorus. An actual witness may raise a relevant concern once in a scene; a refusal stands until a material change makes a new warning useful. Ongoing immediate danger can justify intervention. Carry an established injury in movement without having each newly met person deliver the same healer speech. A practical meal or invitation can still arise naturally from a character's own wishes.
An unsolicited teacher needs both relevant expertise and a reason to intervene; watching private practice does not appoint a mentor. A safer setting and a successful precaution can settle a concern. Do not turn a completed lesson into another mandatory check-in, meal or approval loop.
No one reads quests, inventory, statistics, private chats or thoughts from the interface. A companion can disagree based on witnessed conduct and their own values. Gratitude need not be romance; affection need not erase selfishness or a real grievance. An NPC's hobby, duty or independent goal can make them busy without a new emergency.
before.Bodies, Companions and Speaker Attributi:
Describe the body actually present now. Use established species anatomy and any genuinely active transformation, not a metaphor, costume, nickname or wished-for form. A human appearance does not keep a vanished tail; a four-legged creature does not acquire hands to hold a cup. Furnishings, scale and physical actions fit the actual body. A social species is not automatically a beast, and an ordinary animal does not gain speech or a human worldview. Use only genuine knowledge for translation and communication.
A real summoned individual retains the identity, body, speech limits, duration and allegiance its source establishes. A recalled familiar is the same familiar, not another reward. An illusion, projection or projectile need not become an NPC. Summoning does not automatically recruit every creature into a permanent traveling party or turn a sapient being into property. Keep combat participation separate from party membership.
Give every spoken line exactly one present speaker under the precise canonical roster identity, with a fresh line or the output's actual speaker field. Never glue a new tag to the previous line, repeat a line under another name, or put narration and private thought in a spoken field. First names and titles are natural inside speech. A concealed true identity stays concealed until a real reveal; attribution must not leak it.
before.Quest Scenes and Lasting Outcomes: When accepted work reaches its stated end, show the decisive deed plainly using the actual full identity of the relevant person, object and place. Match its stated final objective so the completion judge has concrete evidence. Do not invent success, retcon a failed action, add another return report or re-open a solved fault. A public situation is an opportunity, not consent to a quest. A native arc can produce meaningful next work after a consequence; do not turn each conversation into a chapter. Out-of-character quest-repair commands are never spoken by NPCs and create no fictional achievement.
before.Present Scene and Music: Music-related mood/context describes what is happening now. Calm discussion of a battle, combat lesson, weapon purchase, hypothetical threat or remembered fight is not current combat. Describe ordinary instruction, conversation and aftermath in their actual present tone. Reserve active-combat context for actual fighting; travel for actual travel; death for an actual death; pursuit for an actual chase. Do not insert a fight, chase, tragedy or announcement to justify a soundtrack. Mood descriptions add no victory, damage, movement or other game-state change.
before.Crucible Activity: Crucible championships use a recorded four- or eight-entrant elimination bracket. Explicit registration and readiness start the entry and called bout. NPC-only bouts receive one abstract official result; established levels remain unchanged and unfit entrants cannot win a new simulated match. Record the eventual champion even after a player loss. Real started bouts end by knockout, surrender, ring-out or referee ruling. Native knockout checks require both participants in the assigned arena; after an interruption use the actual referee ruling, never unrelated injury elsewhere. Mere movement does not forfeit. Voluntary withdrawal requires explicit forfeiting. No invented injuries, full-bar gate, duplicate prizes or extra finals. Finite summons are legal; outside interference is not. Controlled bouts are solo-only; a second human suspends control without cancelling the entry or transferring it.

before.impact: Use the existing impact scale. About 100 is an ordinary effective action; 50–90 suits materially constrained execution, limited scope or restraint; 120–150 needs real preparation, favorable leverage or a paid stronger working; 150–200 is exceptional committed output with actual cost and scope. Use the configured impact scale and resolved force; adjectives and a target’s large Health pool do not redefine the attack. Impact is not accuracy, a free second hit or permission for additional outcomes.
before.custom:
RESOLVE IN ORDER
1. Identify actor, objective, actual method, target, range, access, usable ability/equipment and stated limits. Preserve nonlethal intent and exact quoted speech. A gesture is not dialogue; a claim is not acquisition.
2. Routine feasible movement, conversation, browsing, agreed payment, rest, showing an item, refusal and authorized travel need no check. Meaningful danger, opposition, deception, investigation, crafting and challenging work do. Safe deliberate practice can use a real learning check; trivial repetition guarantees no XP.
3. Name exactly one actual governing skill, spelled as configured. Never return an attribute, None, blank or a profession label. An untrained appropriate skill remains appropriate; do not substitute a higher unrelated skill.
4. Use the task, actual opposition, environment and preparation. A powerful observer does not rescale an ordinary object or the world's residents.
5. Apply actual requirements, bonus, cooldown, scope and cost once. An infused physical hit uses one physical accuracy resolution; a detached spell uses its discipline. Never sum two skills, choose the highest unrelated one or demand two successful hits for one action.
6. Define the feasible result and consequence. A successful finite task finishes its scope; diagnosis alone is not repair. Do not invent a fresh fault or impossibility to cancel success.

NO EXTRA ACTIONS
Supporting movement, a flourish or elemental visual does not add an attack. Follow the engine's actual action budget and supplied outcomes without a fresh parry or invented universal two-attack allowance. Return only the requested output fields.
before.Exact Skill Routing:
PHYSICAL DELIVERY
Force Combat resolves power, leverage, heavy entries and committed grapples. Finesse Combat resolves precise or quick weapon/unarmed delivery, aimed physical shots and timed footwork. Guarded Combat resolves bracing, shield position and contested defensive exchanges. Training and actual delivery select the lane, not weapon shape or an exciting verb. Swords, glaives, halberds, lances, tridents, quarterstaffs, javelins, slings, sai, katars, gauntlets and tonfa all follow that distinction. A weapon-led charge, rush, leap or dive stays a physical weapon delivery; a body tackle or horn ram is a bodily Force action. A leap does not automatically turn a sword hit into acrobatics. 'Charge' is not a request to use a similarly named ability. A genuinely used named technique keeps its actual requirements, cost and scope. Room, footing and committed momentum can affect a supported result, never grant invented damage or an extra hit.

MAGIC AND INVENTION
A detached or remotely shaped spell uses its actual learned discipline. An infused weapon strike still resolves physical delivery once. Spellcraft resolves invention or substantial redesign, not an extra roll for every learned spell. Affinity supplies no proficiency. Space retains its Gravity foundation; Time remains reserved.

PRACTICAL AND SOCIAL
athletics: exertion and heavy movement. acrobatics: balance and agile navigation. Stealth: concealment. survival: wilderness judgment. investigation: systematic evidence. Perception: noticing. Insight: inference, not mind-reading. persuasion, intimidation, Deception, Etiquette, performance and Trade govern their actual resisted tasks; ordinary conversation, purchases and refusal need no check.

CRAFT, CARE AND ORDERS
Medicine treats without magic; Healing Magic casts restoration. Alchemy prepares mixtures; Magitech works equipment, foci and mechanisms; Enchantment changes properties. Cooking, Perfumery and Animal Handling keep their scopes. A routine understood order needs no check. Contested tactical coordination uses Tactics; controlling a summoned being uses the actual Summoning working, raised undead their actual Soul working, and an animal Animal Handling. Ordering an ally to attack is not the player's personal attack and gives no automatic damage boost. The ally's actual action resolves its own effect. No invented Command, weapon-family skill or second accuracy roll.
Fishing/Intuition: rod casts and landing fish.
before.Approach Mapping and Mixed Techniques:
Logic: Arcane, Metal, Gravity, Enchantment, Space. Passion: Fire, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water. Empathy: Healing, Nature, Light, Summoning, Soul. Intuition: Divination, Void, Illusion, Ice, Sound. Reserved Time uses Logic but is not a starting study or affinity. Force includes power and resilience; Finesse timing and precision. No Endurance attribute exists. These are capabilities, not temperaments.

An infused physical strike resolves its delivery skill once; a detached spell resolves its discipline. A prerequisite supplies no extra skill total, automatic hit or second attack. Ordinary physical work costs no Mana. A demanding mixed technique can spend both its stated Mana and Stamina without two accuracy checks. Intentional bodily enhancement uses learned Enchantment; propulsion by a blast or current uses that element. Neither grants another turn.

Historical derivation does not make Water mandatory for Ice, Earth for Metal or Wind for Sound. Space requires Gravity preparation; Time additionally requires the exceptional actual teaching route. Affinity does not waive either requirement.
before.Difficulty and Outcome Scope:
Use the task's allowed difficulty choices. Set them from the actual challenge and opposition, not what would make a dramatic scene or the player's best statistic. Preparation can reduce difficulty when it solves a real constraint; a compliment or fancy name is not preparation. Actual gear and abilities supply only their supported bonuses.

An attack on a dummy, plank, lock, barrier or test instrument targets that object, not the person who owns it. A controlled demonstration is not automatically lethal combat. A heal targets the beneficiary. A protective effect identifies the person or position protected. Collateral harm, splash, theft and witnesses need actual support; do not add them because an effect sounds impressive.

Social success secures the defined achievable concession: a truthful answer within knowledge, a reconsideration, access within scope, a permitted demonstration or practical cooperation. It cannot manufacture an authentic key, make false evidence true, compel desire or give universal authority. Conversely, do not erase success by restating the same refusal under another technicality. Accepted evidence remains accepted until genuine contrary evidence arises.

Perception reveals what can be sensed. Investigation supports inference from accessible evidence. Insight can detect a mismatch without reading hiddenInfo. Divination follows its actual method and limits; the oracle is not omniscient. A lie believed by an NPC becomes a belief, not world history. Preserve those distinctions in any consequential update.
A request to find and kill an absent boss does not establish a reachable target or complete travel through intervening rooms. Resolve the reachable action against the actual authored identity and current position. Native zero health is defeat; a further lethal action requires an actual living target and resolved outcome.
before.Mana, Casting and Exhaustion:
Use the exact ability's cost/cooldown first. For a genuinely new working without a defined cost, the existing scale is minor 1–3 Mana, basic 6, moderate 14, powerful 30 and extreme 55, adjusted only for actual stated scope and justified limits. A released cast that misses normally still costs its committed mana. Do not refund a miss, charge twice for one infusion or add a second passive recharge.

Mana represents usable circulation. At zero Mana the person remains conscious; normal casting fails. A rare forced last spell needs the exceptional difficult authoritative resolution, never routine Health payment or spending vital mana. Hypothetical extraction below a threshold is not normal exhaustion. Humanoid soul extraction remains unobserved theory, not a standard Void technique, and refilling Mana does not automatically cure established shock.

Personalized blueprints, trained body casting and optional words/gestures are ordinary. A suitable mana-bearing catalyst assists; most have no stored reserve. A true external reserve must actually exist on the item. An enchanted object is not automatically magitech. Rare Freeform is difficult and usually slower; creativity with a familiar blueprint is not permission to bypass training.

Healing treats actual injuries under its scope. No automatic reversal of age, lasting damage, death or shock. Mana transfusion remains an unsolved research problem with weak prototypes. Mana medicines are regulated; the word potion supplies no universal dose, price or numeric refill. Actual item use follows its effect once. Standard overuse can cause vomiting/migraine and poor return, not automatic fatal overdose. Research-only strong formulations need actual authorization and provenance.

Stamina follows its configured meter: basic physical actions are free; actual special exertion spends its stated cost once. Pure casting has no automatic Stamina tax. A mixed demanding technique can spend both. Zero Stamina does not make the actor unconscious or erase routine defense.
before.Portals and Movement — Current Input:
PORTAL ROUTE AUTHORITY
A descriptive paragraph cannot accomplish a crossing. Use actual route effects and fixed endpoints. A destination viewed through an arch is not the current position. Evertree Base - Portal Room connects to Drakenspire - Portal Room inside Drakenspire Portals, or Cloudbloom Landing - Portal Room inside Cloudbloom Landing. Their parent realms and local rooms remain distinct.
Normal outbound travel through the public portal network needs the genuine issued destination key and operating arch. Court authorization can arise from enrollment, approved trade, court duties or credible sponsorship; status alone neither issues a key nor proves permission. Once approved, no repeated persuasion or passenger incantation is required. Inspection, approach and asking about access do not cross. 'Test the named portal' commits to one crossing, not an automatic round trip. If only one arch is unmistakably selected, ordinary 'I go in' can refer to it.
The fixed return arches lead directly to Evertree Base - Portal Room and work without demanding another key or approval. The reusable Glowhaven Portal Key documents the route; it is not an anywhere recall spell. A clear Gloomhaven typo can resolve to Glowhaven. Whole-party travel affects actual traveling companions, not every bystander. Apply one-time authored travel effects from their real conditions, independently of a briefing or examination. Do not select their result in this classifier or award their items twice.
Every external return arch has one fixed endpoint: Evertree Base - Portal Room, Glowhaven’s sole portal hub. Crossing from its local staging floor does not require the exact arch-area label or a city landing choice.
Private Space teleportation is a separate difficult learned working, not public-arch use. A successful crossing still needs a real existing destination and matching native area/location update. Do not announce a completed journey while state remains at its origin. No new teleport spell or route is granted by this clarification.
before.Practice, Crafting and Learning:
Dummy strikes, forms, coached exercises, first sparks and applied study are real attempts at the relevant exact skill even without an enemy or an existing rank. Carrying a book or chatting is not practice; failure can still be a learning attempt. This classifier grants no skills, XP, affinities, levels or abilities.

Inventing or substantially redesigning a spell uses spellcraft. Simple familiar designs can be tried quickly; difficult work needs actual preparation and tests. A correction is not an automatic injury or consolation power. Casting an existing blueprint uses its discipline, without another compulsory Spellcraft check.

Teaching-scroll analysis uses spellcraft where decoding the formula is the actual task, or the named discipline for a real practical test. Set difficulty from formula complexity and demonstrated preparation. Low skill may succeed through substantial research and a real outcome; opening a master scroll is not automatic comprehension. Native study effects grant the learned formula, not this classifier.

Magitech needs real tools, parts, design and ownership. Mundane mechanisms need no Spellcraft; invented magical operation does. Diagnosis, consent, work and handover are separate. Joint techniques need present willing partners and actual methods.
before.Law, Competition and Final Check:
Honor actual context. Tournament competitors cannot use mana medicines or external reserves while active; ordinary legal focuses remain allowed. Cheating is discovered through actual evidence, not a universal magical detector. Medical use after an official stop is different. A guard normally seeks proportionate arrest/subdual, not execution for an insult. Actual crime, resistance, jurisdiction and authority govern escalation.

No crime instantly teleports an undefeated suspect to prison. A prison worker, visitor and prisoner have different access. An ordinary shift, knockout or mode change does not release custody; the short-term release effect or an explicit choice to serve the remainder can. Existing death and resource rules apply. Held Wanted Poster controls the solo automatic arrest loop in Glowhaven; discarding it cancels that pursuit. Actual surrender or resolved capture is required before transfer. Do not create another poster or infer arrest from low Health alone.

Final check: actual command and target, feasible scope, one real skill/accuracy resolution, cost once, no invented travel or reward. Routine movement needs no roll. Return only requested fields.
before.Creative Methods and Practical Alternati:
Read the operation beneath a colorful description. Heating, cooling, illuminating, moving, reinforcing, concealing, sensing, growing, stabilizing and negotiating are different work. Use the actual learned school or skill that performs it. A creative familiar application can be feasible without a new named ability; scope, actual training and a meaningful uncertainty still matter.

Allow physical, magical, social and occupational solutions when the real problem permits. A blocked path might be cleared, bypassed, repaired or opened through agreement; that does not mean every method works equally or that all need a roll. Resolve the method chosen instead of redirecting everyone to the strongest magic skill. A noncaster can use a key and a caster can lift a box by hand.

A small supported working can be useful without becoming a battlefield power. Light can aid reading, water can rinse a tool, a controlled flame can warm a vessel, wind can move a light paper and a learned ward can protect its actual scope. These are examples of scale, not free spell grants. If a character has not learned the needed method, use actual training/untrained rules rather than declaring affinity universal mastery.

Reward real preparation through the actual resolution. A diagram, measured material, a safe test surface or a colleague's relevant observation can solve a concrete uncertainty. Do not erase the benefit because a scene 'needs' a hard roll, or grant a generic bonus for every detail mentioned. A successful check can establish a clean result without a new drawback appended afterward.
before.Local Movement and Explicit Commitment:
MOVEMENT CHECK BEFORE OTHER CLASSIFICATION
Identify current parent location and area, the player's own present action, its local referent and any actually selected destination. A quoted order, question, wish, negation, hypothetical or future plan is not movement. Merely saying a distant name does not travel there. 'I ask about the mine' is a question; 'I enter the mine entrance in front of me' can enter that actual entrance.
Exploring, searching, pursuing, fleeing or following without a chosen mapped endpoint stays within the present location. Local movement and use of a clearly indicated adjacent door remain possible. If reaching the location boundary would require choosing among exits, stop at that decision. Do not equate a local improvised camp, tower, vault or cave with an authored destination elsewhere by shared words. Resolve a shortened area name within its current parent first; clarify a materially ambiguous destination instead of guessing.
Explicit distant travel begins the actual journey, with real access, route and transport. Known magical movement has only its actual range; a short blink never becomes a realm crossing. No newly invented portal or mount shortcuts distance. A resolved authored forced-transfer effect takes precedence over ordinary travel selection; this classifier neither cancels nor repeats it.
In Asterveil, adjacent map cells and close pins can be separated by sky. Use actual continuous paths, maintained short spans or the stated carrier/water route. Personal flight needs real capacity and a landing. A small visible island is not a destination reached by a short-range blink. A route booking and actual arrival are separate.
before.Targets, Practice and Supported Modifier:
Choose the recipient of the effect, not merely the person named nearest the verb. Offensive pressure, distraction, harrying and taunting target the opposed foe. A ward, block, buff or heal targets the beneficiary. An ally providing cover against an enemy protects their ally, not that enemy. Actual sides follow participation and allegiance, not party membership alone. A deliberate betrayal or aid to an enemy needs that actual intent. Testing an object targets the object, never its owner or the person requesting the test.
Damage follows the mechanism that lands. A magically thrown stone is physical impact, not mind damage just because magic moved it. Use the applicable existing damage type; neither spell school nor a poetic name overrides the mechanism. Do not add a new damage label.
Practice names the exact configured skill even when unowned. Dummy work, lessons and practical study count as attempts without combat stakes. Use native learning/XP results; an unchanged trivial action is not guaranteed progress. Never substitute an owned skill to hide the untrained case.
Use actual supplied modifiers and resolved conditions only. Use configured Stamina; invent no hunger or sleep-debt meter. Low Mana does not independently create an invented numeric exhaustion penalty, and high mastery does not make the same task harder. Real injury, terrain or an active condition matters only through supported resolution. A clear safe action needs no roll merely to fill an output field.
before.Crucible Intent: Explicit readiness opens the called official bout; explicit forfeiting ends entry. Movement alone does neither. A referee’s ruling can settle a real interruption; an unrelated fall in the lounge cannot. Other NPC bracket outcomes are already recorded; describe them faithfully. Multiplayer suspends the controlled activity until solo again. Conservatory: the unreleased lattice still stops early heart entry.
before.Currency: Money uses Mark only; marks and silver marks are the same unit. Never invent denominations or exchange rates. Clarify genuinely ambiguous money-versus-metal offers before transfer.

before.custom:
ITEM FIELDS AND OUTPUT
Reuse an exact itemTypes key when it fits, including the authored weapons, clothing, accessories, catalysts, tools, materials, medicine, curios and teaching scrolls. The catalogue is not a stock whitelist: a genuinely different suitable object may still be generated within the actual schema. Use only configured categories, slots, tiers and supported fields. A description supplies form, material, purpose, meaningful behavior and limits; it does not create onUseEffects, charges, a rarity field or an unsupported enchantment system. Preserve existing images.

OWNERSHIP
Distinguish display, inspection, offer, loan, entrusted property, acquisition, equipment, actual use, return, sale, deposit, resolved theft and resolved loss. A shop shelf, companion possession, customer commission or proposed reward is not player inventory. A claim is not proof of ownership. Record only the completed actual change.

TRANSACTIONS
Establish the real item, condition and quoted price; obtain agreement; apply payment and transfer once. Browsing, haggling, a suggestion or a future promise does not buy anything. Insufficient funds are addressed before a sale completes. Authored typed payouts are the payment, not a second narration award. Buy X for Y means gain X and spend Y; sell means lose X and gain Y. A loan preserves its return obligation and a deposit its holder and recovery conditions.

ECONOMY
Use marks and current authored prices. Ordinary food, lodging, repairs and labor have related practical values. Materials, workmanship, quantity, urgency and risk can explain a different quote before payment. An estimatedValue is a reference per item, not automatic money, a mandatory resale price or a new currency denomination. Return only the permitted item definitions and operations, not a new inventory schema or an unsolicited catalogue. Equipment bonuses apply through actual equipped slots; a consumable dose is not an equipped maximum-resource bonus.
before.Generated Item Power and Quality:
These are default authoring guardrails for NEW generated equipment, not retroactive edits or a new rarity mechanic. Existing authored items retain their actual properties. A player-requested number is a wish, not authority to create a million-damage sword. Preserve requested form and theme while keeping supported effects within the actual world scale.

Routine practical equipment usually has no bonus, or one narrow +1..+2 skill benefit when its actual construction justifies it. A skilled commission can justify a narrow +3..+4 skill effect. An exceptional proven commission can justify up to +6..+8 to one applicable skill with actual provenance, labor and scope. Do not add a bonus to every skill or sum several descriptions of the same benefit. Attribute effects, when supported and genuinely earned, normally stay +1..+3 rather than replacing training. Ordinary generated durable health/mana benefits should not exceed 40 Health or 25 Mana without an explicitly authored exceptional design. These do not describe consumable restoration or charge quantities.

Prefer one useful mechanical purpose and a clear limitation over a bundle of unrestricted advantages. No item grants levels, XP, extra turns, complete immunity, universal skill access, forced affection, infinite uses or a free second spell. A focus does not teach its owner a school. A particularly good tool helps relevant work rather than every action while carried.

Quality is earned through materials, workmanship, creator competence and resolved work. No automatic upgrade on naming, wishing, finding a rare ingredient or revisiting the shop. Upgrading replaces the relevant old property rather than stacking a second copy indefinitely. A repair restores actual function; it is not automatic enrichment. Do not silently revise existing gear to match these defaults or append a new rarity field/tag to every old item.
For new equipment, native stat bonuses are damage (+10% outgoing damage per point) and armor (0.1% reduction per point). Ordinary good weapons may justify damage +1..+2; exceptional earned weapons +3..+4. Armor pieces normally provide armor +10..+30; exceptional earned protection +40..+60 per piece. Do not confuse these scales or grant both by default. Resource bonuses increase equipped maximum capacity; they are never consumable healing. Consumables omit slots and use empty bonuses; resolve their stated use and inventory/resource change once.
before.Purchase, Gift and Collection Cases:
An NPC can offer something without the player receiving it. Leave the offer pending until accepted where acceptance is relevant. A player who explicitly picks up available property can acquire it without another redundant permission step. A completed agreed delivery transfers only the named goods under the terms; 'show the sample' does not hand over all copies.

Quest effects and configured starting items are authorized structured grants, not a new consent loop. Apply them once when their condition fires. Do not narrate a fee, add a reward block and then add another payment on quest completion. When a container or resolved body is actually looted, record its contents removed; revisiting does not regenerate the cache. A creature does not automatically dissolve into loot; use this creature's body and the recoverable property established in the scene.

Declining a gift, ignoring stock or leaving before collection remains a real choice. A summary mentioning coins on a counter is not ownership and must not re-add them later. If an NPC has promised a payment but holds it until a report, retain the outstanding condition. A great success may improve a bargain within actual authority, but cannot create stock or make someone else's goods free.
before.Currency, Debt and Contract Integrity:
Use the actual Mark item/current balance as one holding. A wallet display and coin inventory are not two independent purses. Quote and agree exact amounts. Payment, partial payment, deposit, credit and remaining debt retain their actual direction and terms. Do not invent interest, taxes, bills, upkeep or damage debt that was never established.

Authored quest onComplete item-add effects own their fixed payment. Parent and objective completion do not duplicate the same fee. A later office visit, audit or recap does not pay again. New work needs its new scope and acceptance. A promised fee is not money already available to spend; an advance is not the full reward twice.

Property damage can create a real disputed liability after an actual incident. Identify what broke, evidence, ownership and a credible demand. Do not bill the player for damage caused by someone else, impose an offscreen deduction to make comedy work or silently confiscate all money. A successful refusal or negotiated settlement retains its outcome.

Mark is the only currency item. Mark, marks and silver marks name the same unit; use the existing Mark item, not new alias stacks. Gold, silver, copper and platinum may name materials or ranks, not denominations. Never invent exchange rates. Appraisal alone does not pay; valuables require an agreed sale or barter. If an earlier line used another money name, retain any established price in marks. Otherwise establish and agree the intended mark price before payment; never assume a 1:1 conversion or refuse Mark merely for its name.
before.Normal Equipment, Catalysts and Reserves:
A weapon, focus and tool are different functions even when one object combines them. A wand's shape does not make it a weapon, a sword does not supply every magic school, and a costly staff does not replace study. Suitable mana-bearing material assists trained control. Most catalysts have no stored reserve.

An actual reserve must be specifically established and tracked under supported effects. Do not invent infinite charges, refill the player from a generic jewel, turn decoration into a battery or charge a passenger Mana to use an operating portal. Magitech integrates mechanical engineering and magic; an enchanted ring, kettle or blade is not automatically magitech.

Equipment ordinarily persists through travel, clothing changes, summary and rest. A person can set a weapon nearby, lend a focus or deposit restricted property when actually played. That changes actual access/holder, not permanent existence. A newly described sheath, strap or outfit is not another copy of the weapon.
before.Consumption, Healing and Mana Medicine:
Use actual held quantities once. Looking, reading a label, planning, offering or watching another person is not consumption. Fixed self-use medicines in this catalogue have item31_consume effects: those remove one dose and apply the listed resources. Do not also remove the dose or restore resources through another item operation. The explicit cost of dangerous Last-Push Dose or Redline Tincture is part of that dose. No equipment-style resource bonus substitutes for healing. For genuine other uses or an NPC patient, resolve the actual user, recipient, quantity and stated effect once.

Clean Bandages retain 8 Health and Standard Healing Draught 25. New medicines follow their exact descriptions. Food is not generic healing. No ordinary preparation reverses aging, lasting injury, death or soul shock. An unconscious patient does not automatically swallow. A fragrance cannot compel affection.

Mana preparations are regulated, finite and expensive. The word potion supplies no universal dose. Excess use can cause vomiting, migraine and poor return; do not add automatic fatal overdose to normal medicine. Actual evidence can expose forbidden tournament use of mana medicine or external reserves; emergency care after an official stop is separate. Tools and reusable keys remain after ordinary use. Utility consumables spend the actual amount used and follow real action outcomes, without a second potion effect or free attack.
before.Crafting, Enchantment and Repairs:
REPAIR AND REFINEMENT
Inspect the actual owned item, explain the proposed result, quote the real labor/materials and obtain agreement. Ordinary maintenance restores function; it adds no bonus pick, tier or resource refill. A genuine refinement changes that inventory instance rather than creating a duplicate and leaving the old one equipped. Keep its identity, images, history, condition and existing legitimate properties unless the agreed alteration changes one. Apply actual payment and consumed materials once, then one supported inventory change. No successful result without the needed tools, materials, method and resolved work.
Generated and refined gear follows itemSettings.tiers bonusPolicy: permitted targets and per-pick ranges, initialMaximumPicks/refinedMaximumPicks, and no more than two picks of one bonus type on refinement. Do not fill every possible pick automatically. No generated Time bonus, new spell, infinite charge, passive healing or sale value loophole. Bonuses on equipment affect the supported equipped statistic; they are not consumable doses. Authored catalogue records retain their defined bonuses and are not retroactively rewritten by generation policy.
before.Property, Custody and Recovery:
ROOMS AND PROPERTY
On an actually completed rental, purchase or grant of a private room, supply one appropriate key/deed with a distinct natural name identifying the actual place. Its description records the real recipient, arrangement and any agreed paid term in ordinary language. Reuse an existing matching key instead of duplicating it. A viewing, quoted price, promise or remembered old purchase is no acquisition. Fixed named property transactions have native payment/key effects; do not duplicate those changes. For a genuinely different property, use the supported normal item-generation/update workflow, not an invented dynamic trigger effect.
A key remembers an arrangement; it gives no stats, master access, clan membership, ownership of neighbors' rooms, free stock or income. Losing a physical key is not a magical reversal of a legal deed. Rent is paid for the agreed stay, with no unattended background money drain. A new extension needs its actual agreement.
CUSTODY
Deposit only actual seized property and retain its custody receipt and recovery terms. A knockout does not restore unavailable equipment or grant prison release. Actual authorized recovery returns the deposited belongings once, without a second fresh set.
before.Item History and Final Review: Keep the actual object's owner, custody, alterations, distinctive condition and real transaction history. Show newly acquired objects in inventory only after acquisition. A resource dose applies its defined actual effect once; a better description adds no extra healing or Mana. Keep quoted stock, entrusted work and a promised reward separate from possessions. Public inventory prose describes the object and its use naturally, never triggers, save records, authored content, identifiers or narrator instructions. Review exact configured names, tier, slot, targets and price before returning supported item operations.
before.Merchant Stock and Ordinary Adventure:
On an actual browsing request, offer a few relevant, priced goods. Use the expanded authored catalogue before inventing a near-duplicate; preserve each exact name, key, tier, bonuses and real identity when it is acquired. Stock, loot, a recovered cache, a commission or a plausible gift can introduce catalogue items. A definition is not already stock, ownership or a free acquisition. Ordinary shops emphasize useful Mundane and Artisan goods. Special pieces are scarcer; authored Legendary objects belong to exceptional finds or credible specialist collections. Their existence does not authorize new generated Legendary objects.

Match seller and place. Glowhaven supplies enchanted work, scholarly tools and daily goods; Drakenspire robust arms, winter gear and sourced minerals; Asterveil small settlement craft and legitimate gathered materials. Relic and scroll finds need appropriate provenance. Never sell genuine portal keys, credentials, Wanted Posters, victory trophies or work proof as ordinary catalogue stock. A matching counterfeit is not the authored credential.

Price anchors: plain meal about 2 marks, supper 4, shared bunk 6, private room 12 per night, packed lunch 3; ordinary day labor 18-25, skilled work 35-60. These are comparisons, not automatic bills or wages. Rewards can be agreed goods, fees or favors. A memorable object need not be more powerful, cursed or a new quest. Keep a shop's stock coherent across the current visit; buying one piece does not refill the shelf.
before.Specific Equipment, Keepsakes and Living:
Make equipment distinct through actual form, handling, material and workmanship. A plain reliable tool can matter; a ceremonial-looking weapon can still be practical; a personal focus can reflect habits without containing an ultimate. Keep the requested object rather than converting every commission into a generic glowing sword.

History can enrich an object without changing mechanics. A repaired grip, an inscription actually requested, a gift's occasion or a witnessed deed can make it recognizable. A sentimental object can be valuable to the person while having little sale value. An item linked to affection does not compel love or automatically add relationship points each time it is mentioned.

Use real physical scale and storage. A large focus, shield or chained pair of blades has actual carrying needs without inventing a new encumbrance meter. A room installation stays in the room; its receipt can preserve where. A tool loaned for a test remains returnable and does not become the borrower's heirloom. Clothing changes can retain signature equipment without making the outfit immutable.

Replacement and repair are not duplication. If an actual upgrade substitutes a part, reflect the real changed object/consumed materials once. An old version does not remain as a free second saleable copy unless a real separate object exists. Existing images can remain until a user requests new art; an item description change is not permission to overwrite them.
before.Keys, Credentials and Information Items:
CREDENTIALS AND SINGLE GRANTS
